name: ahastation
description: AhaStation — 语音会议式 AI 编程协作（数字员工开会）

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:renderer && npm run typecheck:electron
scripts.build:electron: node scripts/clean-dist-electron.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node scripts/copy-preloads.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.test: npm run build:electron && node --test --test-timeout=120000 --import "data:text/javascript,import { register } from 'node:module'; import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'; register('./tests/electron-stub.mjs', pathToFileURL('./'));" tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.prebuild:speaker: node scripts/fetch-speaker-model.mjs
scripts.dist: npm run prebuild:speaker && npm run prebuild:claude-defaults && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 && node scripts/verify-macos-signing.mjs
scripts.dist:dmg: npm run prebuild:speaker && npm run prebuild:claude-defaults && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never && node scripts/verify-macos-signing.mjs
scripts.dist:win: npm run prebuild:speaker && npm run prebuild:claude-defaults && npm run build && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run prebuild:speaker && npm run prebuild:claude-defaults && npm run build && electron-builder --linux --publish never
scripts.dist:linux:arm64: npm run prebuild:speaker && npm run prebuild:claude-defaults && npm run build && electron-builder --linux --arm64 --publish never && node scripts/verify-linux-arm64-package.mjs && node scripts/generate-release-manifest.mjs
scripts.dist:all: npm run dist:dmg && npm run dist:win && npm run dist:linux
